## Educationally Backward Classes (OBCs)  
[ Swamy's Reservations and Concessions]  
1. Definition.OBCs for purposes of reservation would comprise of the castes and communities which are commonly mentioned in both the lists in the Manda! Commission Report and the State Governments' lists. A list of such common categories has been brought out by the Ministry of  
Welfare. However, from this list, certain persons I The rest will be entitled for reservation.
